manual: Build with community-apps/folio/install.sh. Prefers CMake; falls back to folio.pro + qmake6.
Plugins install to ~/.local/share/folio/plugins (Dropbox / LocalSend / Tailscale soft-fail without those binaries).
Space preview needs qml6-module-qtmultimedia and qml6-module-qtquick-pdf; without them Folio still browses files.
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset.
Optional: xdg-mime default folio.desktop inode/directory so omarchy-launch-files opens Folio.
Optional Open/Save: set org.freedesktop.impl.portal.FileChooser=folio in ~/.config/xdg-desktop-portal/portals.conf, then restart xdg-desktop-portal.
If apt cannot match libqt6core for QML modules, place them under ~/.local/lib/qt6/qml/ — install.sh wraps the binary.
